mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: it showed where the diaphragm sits and how routes pass between the regions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two named lower-body slots was clear but fairly predictable; there was not much to figure out once the slots were shown.

surprise.text: The final cutaway brought together blood carrying materials and nerves carrying signals, showing that the same muscle needs both.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The lymph connection was less visually obvious than the named slots, but its return to a neck vein gave it a purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how these connected parts work together. The final assembly made that interesting, though some fitting steps were predictable.
